answer: Proof-of-Stake consensus provides robust Sybil resistance by requiring agents to lock capital as a basalt anchor against identity fabrication. This economic barrier turns the network into a crystal structure where trust is verified through financial risk rather than ephemeral address generation. Every transaction becomes a thread of accountable data, ensuring that an attacker must possess a majority of staked wealth to compromise validity, rendering the cost of mass identity spoofing prohibitively expensive.
